answer: In the 100-year-sliced PCA of the capital matrix, the symbolic-capital components HouseSize, Dagger and HatchetSword behave as a SINGLE COHERENT BLOCK on PC1 and SEPARATE INTO A BIPOLAR CONTRAST on PC2, with the 39 per-slice PC2 scores centred close to zero. Concretely: PC1 of the symbolic submatrix S = [Zhausgr, ZDolch, ZAxtSchwert] absorbs 54.4% of the variance (PC2 adds 28.8%, together 83.2%); all three symbolic variables load with the SAME POSITIVE sign on PC1 - Dagger +0.662 (dominant), HouseSize +0.568, HatchetSword +0.489 - so high PC1 scores mark the late-Neolithic / Old-Bronze-Age slices (PC1 max +3.35 at BCE 1800 LN, +2.69 at BCE 1300 OBA) and low PC1 scores mark the early-Neolithic slices (BCE 4300-3900 all at -1.37). On PC2, sign-normalised with HatchetSword as the dominant-loading anchor, HatchetSword loads +0.791, HouseSize loads -0.609, and Dagger loads -0.061 - after the shared PC1 movement is removed the triad SPLITS: PC2 separates HatchetSword-rich (OBA BCE 1500-1600 at +2.45) from HouseSize-rich (En/Mn BCE 3500-3400 at -1.55) slices while leaving Dagger essentially neutral. The 39 per-slice PC2 scores have min -1.55, q1 -0.41, median -0.13, q3 +0.51, max +2.45 (skew +0.81) and the IQR clusters near zero (-0.41 to +0.51); PC2 is therefore a residual axis on which the symbolic triad is only weakly separated. The full 12-capital PCA (PC1 = 31.8%, PC2 = 20.4%) supports the same reading: all three symbolic variables still load positively on the global PC1 (Zhausgr +0.228, ZDolch +0.279, ZAxtSchwert +0.301), independently confirming the coherent-block status of the symbolic triad on the leading axis of the capital system.

payload.workflow: Loaded data/capital.csv with comma-decimal parsing (no semicolon-delimiter variant detected); kept 39 rows in the 100-yr BCE grid (4300..500), dropped group/color metadata, float-cast all 12 Z columns. Built the symbolic submatrix S = [Zhausgr, ZDolch, ZAxtSchwert] (39x3); verified all three variables have unit-scale Z-score dispersion and are positively correlated (r_HD=0.44, r_DA=0.35, r_HA=0.14). Fit one pooled NumPy PCA on S (eigendecomposition of the covariance matrix, equivalent to correlation PCA because the variables are already standardised); PC1 eigenvalue=1.63 (54.4% of variance), PC2=0.87 (28.8%). Sign-normalised both axes with the dominant-|loading|-symbolic-variable anchor (PC1 anchored on ZDolch with factor -1; PC2 anchored on ZAxtSchwert with factor -1), producing normalised loadings HouseSize +0.568/-0.609, Dagger +0.662/-0.061, HatchetSword +0.489/+0.791. Computed 39 per-slice PC1/PC2 scores: PC1 spans -1.37..+3.35 (skew +0.99, IQR -0.80..+0.82; EN low pole, LN/OBA high pole); PC2 spans -1.55..+2.45 (skew +0.81, IQR -0.41..+0.51, median -0.13; OBA 1500-1600 dominates the right tail, En/Mn 3500-3400 dominates the left tail). Repeated the procedure on the full 12-capital matrix as context: PC1=31.8%, PC2=20.4%, symbolic triad loads positively on PC1 (+0.228 / +0.279 / +0.301) confirming their coherent block status even when economic/material capital dominates the global PC1. Pollen_openness_* was not used. All 10 supporting CSVs and a run log dropped under artifacts/.
